directive.thread_id: launch-video port 2026-11-05, models-research lane, slice yt-library

targets.baseline_commit_message: sort-youtube-watch-later-into-playlists: launch-video tools/yt-library's client, readers, planner, apply and verify, moved byte for byte

preserve: rules scoring: a channel expression matched whole scores 3, a strong title match 3, a weak one 1
a video goes to every playlist scoring 3 or more, at most max_per_video, else its best weak match marked low
titles matching hold_back are held back with a reason
hand-made lists keep their order; rules playlists are ordered by views
empty playlists are dropped; playlists ordered by size; the plan page lists held back and unsorted videos
allowed_deltas: the rules and hand-made lists are the person's settings given in, not files beside the code
the hold back reason is the settings' hold_back_reason
a hand-made list naming a video no longer in Watch Later is refused in words
the plan carries each channel's sign_in_as
banned_substitutions: a person's channels, account numbers, emails, rules or cookies path written in the code
a second reader of the settings row beside tools/settings
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it. Source lines that named the person's channels, accounts and cookies file were left behind; they are the person's settings row.
